title: MSFS 2020: How to get real live traffic & liveries (No Injectors Needed!)
description:
We’ve all seen it: you load into a major hub like Heathrow or JFK, only to be greeted by a "ghost town" of generic, pointy-nosed white planes. It kills the immersion instantly. While external injectors work, they eat up your CPU and are a pain to launch every flight.

In this video, I show you how to "hijack" the MSFS 2020 engine to get 100% free, branded traffic using the "Priority Folder" trick. By providing the sim with high-quality models from FSLTL and AIG, we let the sim do the heavy lifting itself using native FlightAware data. No extra programs to run, just pure immersion.

In this video:
- Why default MSFS data is actually good (but the models are bad).
- How to install FSLTL and AIG models correctly.
- The "Secret Sauce": Using the priority folder trick to force the sim to use the best liveries.
- Side-by-side performance tests: loading times.
- Live verification at London Heathrow (EGLL).

📂 Default MSFS 2020 Community Folder Locations:
Note: You may need to enable "Show Hidden Files" in Windows to see the AppData folder.

Microsoft Store / Game Pass:
C:\Users\YourUserName\AppData\Local\Packages\Microsoft.FlightSimulator_8wekyb3d8bbwe\LocalCache\Packages\Community

Steam:
C:\Users\YourUserName\AppData\Roaming\Microsoft Flight Simulator\Packages\Community
